name: lost-in-the-forest
description: A DOS/EGA-era survival text adventure on a green-phosphor CRT.
author: ivjames

scripts.package:win: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Lost in the Forest '88" --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=out --overwrite --icon=build/icon.ico --ignore="^/(out|build|sync-game\.mjs)($|/)"
scripts.package:linux: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Lost in the Forest '88" --platform=linux --arch=x64 --out=out --overwrite --ignore="^/(out|build|sync-game\.mjs)($|/)"
scripts.package:mac: npm run sync && electron-packager . "Lost in the Forest '88" --platform=darwin --arch=universal --out=out --overwrite --icon=build/icon.icns --ignore="^/(out|build|sync-game\.mjs)($|/)"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:win && npm run package:linux && npm run package:mac
